notes.title: Is That a Phone in your Pocket? Wet Dreams Dry Twice available on iOS & Android!
notes.content:
Oh, behave! 
Today, together with developer [i][b]Crazybunch[/b][/i] we are excited to announce the mobile release of our Leisure Suit Larry - Wet Dreams Dry Twice. 

Now available on [i][b]iOS and Android mobile devices[/b][/i], you can do more than just “swipe right” on our titular heartthrob. Take [i]Larry[/i]’s love quest on the go and help him explore the gorgeous [i]Kalaua’a[/i] archipelago and uncover a deliciously devious plot, all while aiding in finding his one true love. 

Stranded on the island [i]Cancum[/i] after the events of [i][b]Leisure Suit Larry - Wet Dreams Don’t Dry[/b][/i], [i]Larry[/i]’s darling soulmate, [i]Faith[/i], has vanished without a trace, with the only clue to her whereabouts being a weak signal from her PiPhone. Journey through the tropical island paradise in the pursuit of true love, flexing those fingers (on the phone screen, naughty!) solving puzzles and meeting the locals along the way. Faced with an island of beautiful women, will [i]Larry[/i] stay [i]Faith[/i]ful? Or will he give in to temptation? Your call, cupid <3

The sensational sequel to critically renowned [b]Wet Dreams Don’t Dry[/b], [i]Larry Laffer[/i] is no stranger to praise — sitting pretty at 85% positive rating on Steam. Our man’s latest adventure also won 2020’s Adventure Game Of The Year award, receiving acclaim from both new and old point-and-click adventure fans alike. 

[h3]Watch the mobile launch trailer here: [/h3]
[previewyoutube=4y1wIJjCjm0;full][/previewyoutube]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1373430/Leisure_Suit_Larry__Wet_Dreams_Dry_Twice/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38443858/3819c3b68d64f617368209c97247caa75da6120a.jpg[/img][/url]
[list][*] Explore the [i]Kalaua’a[/i] archipelago with all its mysterious and magnificent islands — featuring [b]over 50 beautifully hand-drawn locations.[/b]
[*] [b]Meet over 40 new and old friends[/b] from [i][b]Wet Dreams Don’t Dry[/b][/i] and chat up some fresh new feminine friends.
[*] Help Larry solve difficult and exciting (and maybe a little erotic) new riddles and complete quests, providing him with a truly happy ending.[/list]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1373430/Leisure_Suit_Larry__Wet_Dreams_Dry_Twice/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38443858/cd3d66df2beb27e57c4eec6dcc0781c2c1d23ee5.jpg[/img][/url]
To make up for his naughty behavior, romance expert [i]Larry Laffer[/i] and [i][b]Assemble[/b][/i] have teamed up with [i][b]ShareTheMeal[/b][/i] to promote a [b]‘Save the World’ Edition[/b] of the title on PC here Steam. 
This edition contains the official soundtrack and digital artbook, with every purchase guaranteeing two meals for hungry children around the world. 

[b]Larry’s amorous adventure sequel is also available on PlayStation 4, Xbox One, and Nintendo Switch.[/b]

notes.title: Leisure Suit Larry - Wet Dreams Dry Twice Out Now on Consoles!
notes.content:
[i][b]The Long-Running Classic Franchise Finds Loveable Loser Larry Laffer Looking for Love...Again...on Nintendo Switch, Xbox One, and PlayStation 4[/b][/i]

Everyone’s favorite polyester Prince Charming is bringing his search for love to the living room! 
Leisure Suit Larry: Wet Dreams Dry Twice, the latest award-winning entry in the long-running and beloved point-and-click adventure series, is now available on [b]Nintendo Switch, Xbox One, and PlayStation 4[/b]! 
Together with developer [i][b]CrazyBunch[/b][/i] we have unleashed the endearing Lothario’s latest quest for companionship on consoles following the PC version winning [i][b]“Best Classic Adventure of 2020”[/b][/i] from the [b]Adventure Game of the Year (AGOTY) Awards[/b]. 
From the comfort of your family room to your morning commute on the subway, there’s never been a better time to jump into Larry’s world and see why players have been enjoying his escapades for the last four decades. 

[h3]About Leisure Suit Larry - Wet Dreams Dry Twice[/h3]
In Leisure Suit Larry: Wet Dreams Dry Twice, you will need to guide our plucky protagonist through more than [b]50 beautiful, hand-drawn locations[/b], [b]meeting hilarious characters new and old[/b], and [b]solving cheeky, and sometimes deviously naughty puzzles[/b] along the way. 
Currently enjoying a “Very Positive” review metric on Steam following a successful run on PC, console Casanovas can now join the adventure and see why fans and point-and-click enthusiasts have been following Larry’s misadventures for nearly 35 years.

[h3]Watch the Leisure Suit Larry - Wet Dreams Dry Twice console release trailer: [/h3]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6AaTW7zWuTo

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1373430/Leisure_Suit_Larry__Wet_Dreams_Dry_Twice/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38443858/3819c3b68d64f617368209c97247caa75da6120a.jpg[/img][/url]
[list][*] [b]Optimized for Max Levels of Love:[/b] The team at CrazyBunch has been hard at work perfecting the game for a smooth and enjoyable console experience, providing Nintendo Switch, Xbox One, and PlayStation 4 owners the best possible version of the title.
[*] [b]Who Doesn’t Love Larry?:[/b] Wet Dreams Dry Twice brings the saucy humour, cheeky puns, and sometimes blatant innuendos that fans of the series are after, along with tried-and-true Point-and-Click gameplay, beautiful art, and brilliant voice-acting.
[*] [b]I Can Resist Anything Except Temptation:[/b] Although Larry is officially in love, he’ll still have to avoid falling for the wiles of more than 40 unique and loveable characters, some from his past, some brand new.[/list]

Published by Assemble Entertainment and developed by Crazybunch, Leisure Suit Larry - Wet Dreams Dry Twice is now available on PlayStation 4, Xbox One and Nintendo Switch with digital store versions at $44.99 USD, and PlayStation 4 and Switch retail versions available for $39.99 USD. 
💡 When getting the digital Xbox One or Nintendo Switch version on the respective consoles digital stores, save yourself -20% off with an exclusive and time-limited launch-discount!

Players can also grab the Windows PC and Mac versions via Steam here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1373430/Leisure_Suit_Larry__Wet_Dreams_Dry_Twice/

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1373430/Leisure_Suit_Larry__Wet_Dreams_Dry_Twice/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38443858/cd3d66df2beb27e57c4eec6dcc0781c2c1d23ee5.jpg[/img][/url]
Assemble Entertainment has teamed up with charitable organization [url=https://sharethemeal.org/en/index.html]ShareTheMeal[/url] to launch a [b]Save the World ($44.99 USD) edition of the game[/b]. [h3]Every purchase guarantees two meals for hungry children around the world, which is available here on Steam, too![/h3]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1373430/Leisure_Suit_Larry__Wet_Dreams_Dry_Twice/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38443858/1d733d304db8dd599b16fc8c305d7aa2e9957c91.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Leisure Suit Larry - Wet Dreams Dry Twice — Coming to Consoles May 2021
notes.content:
[i][b]Curl that chest hair and polish up your best gold chain, because legendary ladies man Larry Laffer is headed to Xbox One, PlayStation 4, and Nintendo Switch on May 18, 2021, in Leisure Suit Larry: Wet Dreams Dry Twice.[/b][/i]

Together with developer [b]CrazyBunch[/b] we are more excited than [i]Larry[/i] when English Leather cologne goes on sale, especially with the PC version winning “Best Classic Adventure of 2020” from the Adventure Game of the Year (AGOTY) Awards.

[h3]Watch the Leisure Suit Larry - Wet Dreams Dry Twice console teaser trailer on YouTube:[/h3]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DG8sRXETxHY


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38443858/0dbae4d8ea06de63535ea07f3aedb1d73ff23baf.jpg[/img]
About Leisure Suit Larry - Wet Dreams Dry Twice
Help Larry track down his missing soulmate, the lovely Faith, who has mysteriously disappeared in the tropical paradise of Kalau’a — now from the comfort of your couch or on the go!
Currently enjoying a “Very Positive” review metric on Steam and a successful run on the original love machine, aka the PC, Wet Dreams Dry Twice is everything the long-running and legendary adventure series is known for: a plucky protagonist, more than 50 gorgeous, hand-drawn locations to explore, new friends as well as beloved recurring characters from previous games, and of course, plenty of naughty puns and hilarious puzzles to solve.
“Wet Dreams Dry Twice was a big hit on the PC, and it’s our pleasure to finally share the even cheekier adventures of Larry with console players,” said Assemble Entertainment CEO Stefan Marcinek. “There’s a charm to this series that keeps players coming back again and again, and Larry’s latest quest might be his most important of all.”
In the events of the last game, our heartsick hero Larry Laffer found himself stranded in Cancum and ready to leave the single life behind. Unfortunately, one thing led to another and Larry’s true love and future wife (hopefully) Faith has disappeared somewhere amongst the sunny series of islands in the Kalau’a Archipelago. Can Larry avoid temptation and stay focused enough to find out what happened and reunite with Faith?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38443858/3819c3b68d64f617368209c97247caa75da6120a.jpg[/img]
[list][*] [b]Ho'i Hou Ke Aloha:[/b] Fans of the previous games as well as newcomers will find plenty to fall in love with (again) in Larry’s latest adventure as he treks across the stunning tropical archipelago of Kalau’a, brought to life with beautiful hand-drawn visuals.
[*] [b]Cheeky Puns? We’ve Got Plenty: [/b]It wouldn’t be a Leisure Suit Larry game without a bevy of spicy jokes, suggestive visuals, and good ‘ol fashioned dirty punnery.
[*] [b]One at a Time Ladies!:[/b] During his quest for love, Larry will be tempted and teased by more than 40 “fleshed-out” characters, some from his nefarious past, some brand new.[/list]

[h2]Leisure Suit Larry - Wet Dreams Dry Twice will release on PlayStation 4, Xbox One and Nintendo Switch on May 18, 2021![/h2]

[h3]Players can also grab the Windows PC and Mac here on Steam.[/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1373430/Leisure_Suit_Larry__Wet_Dreams_Dry_Twice/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38443858/cd3d66df2beb27e57c4eec6dcc0781c2c1d23ee5.jpg[/img]
We have teamed up with [b]ShareTheMeal[/b] to launch a [b]Save the World edition[/b] of the game.
[b]Every purchase guarantees two meals for hungry children around the world.[/b]
Players can also grab the Save The World Editon for Windows PC and Mac here on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1373430/Leisure_Suit_Larry__Wet_Dreams_Dry_Twice/

notes.title: Larry Bares It All in New Video for Leisure Suit Larry - Wet Dreams Dry Twice
notes.content:
Hold on to your butts — as Assemble Entertainment today released a brand-spankin’-new gameplay trailer for the upcoming point-and-click adventure, Leisure Suit Larry - Wet Dreams Dry Twice. 
[b]Launching on Windows PC and MacOS via Steam on October 15[/b], Larry’s newest adventure sees the loveable self-proclaimed ladies man set sail on the high seas to reclaim his love! 

Larry Laffer can’t seem to catch a break, and this new gameplay trailer showcases some of his most noteworthy lovestruck fumbles and successes as he ventures to the edge of the world searching for Faith, his one true love...for now. 
There’s no telling where Larry might end up in this new adventure, but if one thing’s certain, it’ll probably include a gimp suit. 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JMq4xPmeWvY


[h3]More about Leisure Suit Larry - Wet Dreams Dry Twice [/h3]
Hey ladies, it’s time to return to Larry-town! 
This may come as a surprise to some, but I am still going strong! That’s right, I’m a real stamina stallion! I left New Lost Wages, got stranded in Cancum, and had prepared to marry my only true love, Faith. But unforeseen events interrupted us and we’ve become separated again! 
She is somewhere in the famous, sunny, and huge Kalau’a archipelago and I have to find her. Help me! If I don’t find her soon, I think I may burst! 

No obstacle will keep me away from my beloved, my Faith, not even the wild and untamed islands of Kalau’a. Those lovely island ladies can only distract me for so long as my heart’s compass only points in one direction - Faith!. Care to set sail with me as a true pirate and become a real gold digger? Join my crew on this glorious tripper — you may just end up soaked to the bone!

[h3]Features:[/h3]
[list][*] Explore the Kalaua’a archipelago with all its mysterious and magnificent islands — featuring over 50 beautifully hand-drawn locations
[*] Meet over 40 new and old friends from Wet Dreams Don’t Dry and chat up some fresh new feminine friends
[*] Help Larry solve difficult and exciting (and maybe a little erotic) new riddles and complete quests, providing him with a truly happy ending
[*] Published by Assemble Entertainment and developed by Crazybunch, Leisure Suit Larry - Wet Dreams Dry Twice will launch on Windows PC and Mac via Steam on October 15, 2020.[/list]

notes.title: Happy Ending Epilogue - Savegame Hotfix
notes.content:
[h1]Happy Ending Epilogue - Savegame Hotfix[/h1]

Since we included the free "Happy Ending"-Update, several players reported issues with the savegames to us. The latest hotfix took care of this:
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug in the savegame system that made it impossible to save the game after the happy ending update.
[/list]

Have fun and stay tuned for more [b]Larry[/b]!

notes.title: Leisure Suit Larry: Wet Dreams Don't Dry - Happy Ending Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32836174/1478b3eefa7bb4828d192d7a498384788d848e76.png[/img]

[b]Leisure Suit Larry - Wet Dreams Don't Dry[/b] was released exactly one year ago today - time for birthday presents! [b]Assemble Entertainment[/b] and [b]Crazybunch[/b] have released today a free Happy Ending Update for the latest Point & Click adventure for PC, acclaimed by critics and fans alike! The update for the console and mobile versions will follow later this year.

[b]The Happy Ending Update brings[/b]:[list]
[*][b]extended playtime[/b]
[*][b]controller support for PC[/b]
[/list]
In brand new game scenes, you will experience the rise of Prune up close and learn what happened to Faith, Larry's lady of the heart, after the end of Leisure Suit Larry - Wet Dreams Don't Dry! And what would a free content update be without your own trailer?

notes.title: Patch 1.0.4 is now live!
notes.content:
Dear Larrys out there,

please find the following patch notes for patch 1.0.4

[list]
[*]The inventory has been reworked and extended in order to improve the inventory's usability.

[*] An overlay, which explains the controls, will be displayed at certain points in the game (mouse controls and keyboard shortcuts).

[*] A caption "skip" has been added in order to highlight the skip-button (quiz).

[*] Fixed a bug, which let Larry die by the router power cord even after the Wi-Fi connection has been restored in Lefty's Bar. 

[*] Fixed a bug, which allowed Larry to obtain the Sleaze Wars figurine without having the dollar bill.

[*] Fixed a bug, which incorrectly displayed the Timber App with some resolutions.

[*] Fixed a bug, which made some players bisexual.

[*] Several minor bugfixes and improvements.[/list]

We hope you still enjoy Larry in his new adventure. Just let us know how you like the new improvements and you are still invited to give us your feedback about what we can still do better.

Thank you for your support and hope we see each other again soon (K)

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3 is now live!
notes.content:
Dear Community,

update 1.0.3 is now available with a few quick fixes.

Changelog:
- Fixed a bug, which allowed players to obtain unlimited buckets in Cancum.
- Fixed a bug, which caused problems with several UI elements when changing to specific resolutions (e.g. ultra wide resolution).
- Updated some speechfiles which had incorrect or misleading content. Cébé now will tell the player the correct Timber score for entering the night club Hell's Pawn, which is 25.

Thank you for your support on LSL - Wet Dreams Don't Dry. We are still excited about your feedback, so please continue and let us know about your Larry Laffer experience.
